Method of Attack: Encrypts files on servers and network shares, appends .dxxd to encrypted files, creates ransom notes ReadMe.txt, modifies Windows registry keys to display ransom note before login
Hacking into servers using Remote Desktop Services and brute forcing passwords
Attack Vector: Remote Desktop Services brute force attack
Indicators of Compromise: Registry keys HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon\LegalNoticeCaption and LegalNoticeText configured to display ransom note
